senses.gloss: m. (גמם) a field which requires clearing in order to be made arable, uncleared ground containing roots of trees &c.
units: <cite ref="Avodah Zarah 38a:6">Ab. Zar. 38ᵃ</cite> <he>הצית את האור בא׳</he> set fire to an uncleared field. Y. ib. II, 44ᵈ bot. <he>א׳ תמרים</he> a field on which palms stood, the roots of which must be grubbed up.
